description: In what order do the MMP rows (Memo equal up to p, different at p) come from ORDER BY the Memo column with id as the second key, ascending and descending, from ORDER BY Left(m, 255) and ORDER BY m & '' (a Text-converted key) with the same second key, and from ORDER BY the Memo column alone? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
